SELECT 
  fish_date_doy as doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 168 AND fish_date_season = 6
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls

SELECT 
  ts_doy as doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 2) as avg_wtmp_c,
  ROUND(MIN(wtmp_c), 2) as min_wtmp_c,
  ROUND(MAX(wtmp_c), 2) as max_wtmp_c
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6 AND ts_doy >= 170 AND ts_doy <= 182
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC

SELECT 
  index_id,
  avail_doy,
  ROUND(value, 2) as value
FROM climate
WHERE avail_season = 6
ORDER BY avail_doy DESC, index_id
LIMIT 20

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Get schedule for next 14 days
schedule = tables['schedule']
trips = tables['trips']

# Filter for S6 and fish_date d183-d196 (next 14 days)
sched_next14 = schedule[
    (schedule['fish_date_season'] == 6) & 
    (schedule['fish_date_doy'] >= 183) & 
    (schedule['fish_date_doy'] <= 196)
].copy()

# Get recent 14-day boat performance by class
recent_trips = trips[
    (trips['fish_date_season'] == 6) & 
    (trips['fish_date_doy'] >= 168) & 
    (trips['fish_date_doy'] <= 182)
].copy()

# Calculate boat+class performance
boat_class_perf = recent_trips.groupby(['boat', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'fish_date_doy': 'count'
}).reset_index()

boat_class_perf['yt_per_angler'] = boat_class_perf['yt'] / boat_class_perf['anglers']
boat_class_perf.columns = ['boat', 'cls', 'yt', 'anglers', 'trips_14d', 'yt_per_angler']
boat_class_perf = boat_class_perf.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)

print("=== NEXT 14 DAYS SCHEDULE (d183-d196) ===")
print(f"Total scheduled trips: {len(sched_next14)}")
print(f"\nTrips by class:")
print(sched_next14['cls'].value_counts())

print("\n=== TOP BOAT+CLASS COMBOS (last 14 days) ===")
print(boat_class_perf[boat_class_perf['yt_per_angler'] > 0.5][['boat', 'cls', 'yt_per_angler', 'trips_14d']].head(20))
